reading: The recent summit between Trump and Xi in Washington was notable for what was not explicitly said.
On Monday, China released details of some concrete outcomes from the talks.
However, the summit produced no joint statements and few major breakthroughs.
Instead, both governments issued separate accounts, suggesting they remain wary of each other.
Beijing and Washington agreed to launch a new dialogue on artificial intelligence.
They also established a communication channel for AI-related incidents to prevent broader confrontation.
Chinese state media confirmed the trade truce has been extended until January 10.
However, Beijing had hoped for a much longer extension to this truce, making it a modest gain.
China secured lower tariffs on $30bn of goods entering the US, with reciprocal reductions expected.
Strikingly, there was no mention of increasing China's rare earth mineral exports to the US.
The White House factsheet made no mention of Taiwan, although it was clearly a priority for Xi Jinping.
According to Beijing, Xi urged Trump to formally oppose Taiwan independence.
The US State Department continues to classify travel to China as a Level 2 advisory, urging increased caution.
Ultimately, contentious issues from advanced technology to Taiwan remain unresolved after the summit.

vocabulary.definition: Results or achievements that are definite and clearly visible, not just ideas or plans.
Important discoveries or developments that help solve a problem.
Feeling or showing caution about possible dangers or problems.
A formal discussion between two groups or countries, especially to resolve problems.
A hostile or argumentative meeting or situation between opposing parties.
A temporary stop or pause in a trade war or disputes between countries.
Taxes imposed by a government on imported or exported goods.
A thing that is regarded as more important than others.
Not solved or settled; still needing an answer or a decision.

entries.ja: 重要で興味深い、注目に値する。
entries.zh-Hans: 重要的或有趣的；值得关注的。
entries.es: Importante o interesante; que merece atención.
entries.pt-BR: Importante ou interessante; que merece atenção.

entries.ja: 単なる考えや計画ではなく、明確で目に見える確実な結果や成果。
entries.ko: 단지 아이디어나 계획이 아니라, 명확하고 분명하게 보이는 결과나 성과.
entries.zh-Hans: 明确且清晰可见的结果或成就，而非仅仅是想法或计划。
entries.es: Resultados o logros que son definidos y claramente visibles, no solo ideas o planes.
entries.pt-BR: Resultados ou conquistas que são definidos e claramente visíveis, não apenas ideias ou planos.

entries.ja: 問題の解決に役立つ重要な発見や発展。
entries.ko: 문제 해결에 도움이 되는 중요한 발견이나 발전.
entries.zh-Hans: 有助于解决问题的重要发现或发展。
entries.es: Descubrimientos o desarrollos importantes que ayudan a resolver un problema.
entries.pt-BR: Descobertas ou desenvolvimentos importantes que ajudam a resolver um problema.

entries.ja: 起こりうる危険や問題に対して警戒心を感じたり示したりすること。
entries.ko: 발생할 수 있는 위험이나 문제에 대해 조심하거나 경계하는 느낌을 보이거나 갖는.
entries.zh-Hans: 对可能存在的危险或问题感到或表现出谨慎。
entries.es: Sentir o mostrar precaución ante posibles peligros o problemas.
entries.pt-BR: Sentir ou demonstrar cautela sobre possíveis perigos ou problemas.

entries.ja: 特に問題を解決するために、二つのグループや国々の間で行われる公式な話し合い。
entries.ko: 주로 문제를 해결하기 위해 두 집단이나 국가 간에 이루어지는 공식적인 논의.
entries.zh-Hans: 两个团体或国家之间进行的正式讨论，特别是为了解决问题。
entries.es: Una discusión formal entre dos grupos o países, especialmente para resolver problemas.
entries.pt-BR: Uma discussão formal entre dois grupos o países, especialmente para resolver problemas.

entries.ja: 対立する当事者間の敵対的または議論の多い会合や状況。
entries.ko: 서로 대립하는 당사자들 사이의 적대적이거나 논쟁적인 만남 또는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 对立各方之间发生的充满敌意或争论的会面或情况。
entries.es: Un encuentro o situación hostil o argumentativa entre partes opuestas.
entries.pt-BR: Um encontro ou situação hostil ou argumentativa entre partes opostas.

entries.ja: 国々間の貿易戦争や紛争が一時的に停止または中断すること。
entries.ko: 국가 간의 무역 전쟁이나 분쟁이 일시적으로 중단되거나 멈추는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 国家之间贸易战或争端暂时停止或暂停。
entries.es: Una detención o pausa temporal en una guerra comercial o disputas entre países.
entries.pt-BR: Uma parada ou pausa temporária em uma guerra comercial ou disputas entre países.

entries.ja: 政府が輸入品または輸出品に課す税金。
entries.zh-Hans: 政府对进口或出口商品征收的税。
entries.es: Impuestos impuestos por un gobierno sobre bienes importados o exportados.
entries.pt-BR: Impostos impostos por um governo sobre bens importados ou exportados.

entries.ja: 他のものよりも重要と見なされること。
entries.ko: 다른 것들보다 더 중요하게 여겨지는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 被认为比其他事物更重要的事情。
entries.es: Una cosa que es considerada más importante que otras.
entries.pt-BR: Uma coisa que é considerada mais importante que outras.

entries.ja: 解決されていない、または決着がついていないこと。まだ答えや決定が必要な状態。
entries.ko: 해결되거나 결론 나지 않은; 여전히 답이나 결정이 필요한.
entries.zh-Hans: 没有解决或确定；仍然需要答案或决定的。
entries.es: No resuelto o no establecido; que aún necesita una respuesta o una decisión.
entries.pt-BR: Não resolvido ou não estabelecido; que ainda precisa de uma resposta ou decisão.
